One senior kart has hand controls for drivers with reduced mobility; rain gear is available.
group: Kids' kart parties for ages 3-6 and 7-13.
Company events, conference facilities and a cafe on site.
hours: Season to 31 Oct: 5-25 Oct Sat-Sun 10:00-16:00 (weekdays bookings only); 26-31 Oct daily 10:00-15:00; closed for the season from 1 Nov

family: Two go-kart attractions inside the Skara Sommarland theme park: Formula Indycart (min. 160 cm) and Imola 2000 (min. 135 cm).
Both go-kart rides require a separate ticket on top of park entry.
Imola 2000 is listed as temporarily closed.
There is no age limit; drivers need to be 140 cm and reach the pedals.
Smaller children can ride a duo kart with an adult; up to 3 duo karts run at once.
Summer drop-in costs SEK 220 for 8 minutes; the track may close in heavy rain.
group: Timed races can be booked outside regular opening hours.
hours: Summer drop-in season only (2026: 20 Jun-9 Aug); currently closed for the season

family: The club rents out three try-out karts on selected Sundays 11:00-16:00 so newcomers can try karting before buying their own.
Try-out karts: Cadetti from age 6, Micro from age 8 and J60 from age 10.
hours: Club training Tue and Thu 17:00-20:00, Sun 11:00-16:00, only when a training marshal is listed; try-out rental on selected Sundays 11:00-16:00
note: Club's 'Hyrkart' link goes to motorstadion.se/uddevalla, a separate rental operator not confirmed at Glimminge; that page also contains embedded spam text, so nothing from it was used.

family: There is no age limit; standard karts need 145 cm and junior karts (50 km/h) 125 cm.
Drop-in needs no booking: SEK 200 for 8 minutes on the shared outdoor track.
Race karts (120 km/h, dry weather only) are available in packages from age 15.
Birthday parties include a pizza buffet and fika.
group: Bookings from 6 people get a guaranteed start time with qualifying and final, alone on the track.
Company events combine karting with multi-activity contests and food; stag/hen parties and Le Mans team races are offered.
Paintball is available nearby through a partner.
hours: Outdoor drop-in Tue-Fri 12:00-18:00, Sat 14:00-18:00, Sun varies (see Facebook)

family: Drop-in costs SEK 200 per person for 8 minutes with a 140 cm height limit; it cannot be pre-booked.
Drop-in runs on Saturdays, weather permitting.
group: Races and Le Mans team races can be booked any day of the week, at least one day ahead.
hours: Drop-in Sat 11:00-18:00 weather permitting; other days bookings only; closes for the season 31 Oct

family: Driving starts at age 6 and 115 cm on a mini kart with 4-point belts; speed levels step up by age and height (8-10 yrs/125 cm, 10-13 yrs/135 cm, 13+/150 cm).
Drop-in races give 8 timed minutes from SEK 130; family members may drive mixed speed levels in the same race.
RX250 performance karts (15/22 hp) are for drivers from 15 and 150 cm who first set a qualifying lap time.
Drivers under 18 may only drive with a parent or guardian present.
group: Event and race bookings daily 10:00-22:00 from April to October, normally with a week's notice (same-day possible in high summer).
hours: Season Apr-Oct. Drop-in: Apr and Oct Sat-Sun 11:00-16:00; May and Sep Sat-Sun 11:00-18:00; Jun wks 23-25 and Aug wks 34-35 Sat-Sun 11:00-19:00; Jun wk 26, Jul and Aug wks 31-33 daily 11:00-20:00. Bookings daily 10:00-22:00

family: Two double karts with seatbelts let adults ride with children under 10 or people who cannot drive alone; staff check that the belt fits.
A single kart with hand controls is available.
Drop-in shares the track with others when it is not booked, with lap timing.
group: Races give your group the track to yourselves and need at least 8 drivers; groups over 20 should call or email.
Club SMK Vasteras offers karting from the year a child turns 6 (racing from 8).
hours: Rental (Halla Gokart), week 41: Mon-Tue closed; Wed 12-17; Thu-Fri 12-18; Sat-Sun 14-18
note: Listed site is the club SMK Vasteras; public rental at Halla Ring is run via hallagokart.se, linked from the club's Hyrkart page.

family: Electric karts (about 70 km/h) need drivers of at least 135 cm to reach the pedals; 8 minutes cost SEK 180.
The indoor track is about 160 m with 1-4 karts on track at once.
The venue also has Boda Borg, laser tag and a Mini Multi play area for the youngest children.
group: Grand Prix for groups of at least 4 with qualifying heats, a final and medals (SEK 355 per person).
Packages for birthday parties, school and group trips, company events, conferences and stag/hen parties.
hours: Mon-Tue closed; Wed-Thu 10:00-16:00; Fri-Sat 10:00-20:00; Sun 10:00-16:00 (may change in holidays)

family: Adult karts are from age 12 and 155 cm; kids' karts from 130 cm (10 minutes CHF 23).
A two-seater lets a child ride with an accompanying adult (CHF 35 per 10 minutes).
Five new Tony Kart kids' karts join the fleet from November 2026; a Kinder Driver Academy trains on Wednesdays and Saturdays.
The 420 m indoor track uses petrol karts; helmets and protective gear are provided.
group: Exclusive hall rental from 30 minutes (CHF 750), also outside regular hours including Mondays and Tuesdays.
Lap races of 30-50 laps for up to ten drivers aged 16+, plus a public race on the first Wednesday of the month.
hours: Wed-Sun (times via the 'Wann kann ich fahren?' booking page); Mon-Tue for exclusive group rental only

family: Ticket rides on the indoor electric track are possible from 1.40 m tall; 8 minutes cost CHF 24 including briefing, helmet and timing.
Kids' birthday package for children up to 14: 3 x 8 minutes for up to 6 children (CHF 360) with a drink, snacks and best-time ranking.
group: Exclusive track rental of 30 minutes (CHF 720) or 60 minutes (CHF 1,200), with racing possible.
Larger groups and team events are arranged by email; medals and trophy sets can be added.

family: Minimum height is 140 cm for the regular sessions; the 800 m Super Track Tuesday is from age 16.
Kleiner Mittwoch (8 minutes, CHF 20) is aimed at younger drivers.
Electric karts reach about 60 km/h on a 450 m outdoor sprint track.
Public transport travellers get 10% off with the RhB railway combined offer.
group: Exclusive track rental and individual events for groups, best booked early via the contact form.
Race Thursday offers qualifying and race against other drivers (2 x 15 minutes, CHF 70).
hours: Season 27 Mar-31 Oct 2026: Mon-Tue 17:00-21:00; Wed 13:00-21:00; Thu-Fri 17:00-21:00; Sat 13:00-21:00; Sun 10:00-19:00 (may close early when quiet)
note: Kart page states motor power as 600 W, which seems implausibly low for a 60 km/h kart; recorded as stated.
Not checked: kartbahnlyss.ch (with and without www, and /preise) returns an empty page to the fetcher (likely JavaScript-rendered). Same website as way/163895648; probably the same venue.

family: Kids' minikarts (40 km/h) are for ages 8-13 from 130 cm, on Wednesdays and Sundays 14:00-15:00 (CHF 19 per 10 minutes).
Adult karts (9 hp, 70 km/h) are from age 14; 10 minutes CHF 25.
Helmet and balaclava are included in the price.
group: Group packages for at least 8 adults from 14 years in morning or midday slots: Grand Prix (CHF 65 with cup), Oro and Argento.
hours: Daily from 14:00 (Wed and Sun adults from 15:00): May-Aug 14:00-19:00; Mar-Apr and Sep-Oct 14:00-18:00; Nov and Feb 14:00-17:00; Dec-Jan closed

note: Not checked: kartbahnlyss.ch (with and without www, and /preise) returns an empty page to the fetcher (likely JavaScript-rendered). Same website as relation/7225161; probably the same venue.

family: Drivers must be at least 8 years old and 1.30 m tall; 8 minutes cost CHF 25 for adults and CHF 19 for children up to 15.
18 quiet electric karts run on hydropower on an outdoor track that opens only when dry.
A karting school for ages 8-15 runs Mon and Wed mornings in the summer holidays (CHF 60, max 8 children).
group: Group race packages for 10+ people (Daytona, Imola, Hockenheim, CHF 70-90 per person) with qualifying, final and award ceremony.
Exclusive track rental for company events or private parties from CHF 800 for the first hour.
hours: Main season (6 Jul-16 Aug, 26 Sep-25 Oct 2026, 21 Dec 2026-3 Jan 2027) daily 10:00-12:00 and 13:00-18:00; off-season Wed and Fri 13:00-18:00, Sat-Sun 10:00-12:00 and 13:00-18:00; seasonal break 4 Nov 2026-2 Apr 2027
note: Page lists 21 Dec 2026-3 Jan 2027 as main season but also a seasonal closure 4 Nov 2026-2 Apr 2027 and 'winter closed'.

family: Sodi SR4 standard karts need 1.50 m; the Sodi RSX 2 electric kart is available from 1.30 m.
Price categories: children 1.30-1.50 m, youth from 1.50 m up to 16, adults from 17; each ride lasts 8 minutes incl. helmet, overall and lap-time printout.
A Sodi RT8 kart is offered for drivers with a handicap.
The site calls itself the largest indoor kart track in Switzerland and has a restaurant open daily.
group: Group event packages, Grand Prix reservations, stag parties (Polterabend) and kids' birthday parties are offered.
Seminar rooms, brunch and event spaces are available.
hours: Mon-Fri 09:00-00:00; Sat-Sun 08:00-00:00 (Mon from 15:00 two-wheelers only, Grand Prix group reservations possible)

family: Karting is from 1.30 m; Family rides for children, families and beginners cost CHF 23 for 8 minutes.
Race rides for experienced drivers are from 1.30 m or 14 years (CHF 26).
28 adjustable Tomkart electric karts run on a multilevel 320 m indoor and 100 m outdoor track.
Wednesday 3-for-2 Family offer and a 2-for-1 birthday ride with official ID; duckpin bowling and a bistro on site.
group: Grand Prix, stag parties and group events from 8 people; 2-hour team races and exclusive track hire from 20.
Kids' birthday parties from 6 children.
After-work races on Tuesday and Thursday from 19:00.

family: Junior karts (5.5 PS) are from 1.20 m, and all first-time guests start on them.
Unthrottled 9 PS Sodi SR5 karts require 1.50 m and age 16; the track manager decides.
Minors without parents need a signed consent form and their own ID.
Happy Day: 3 x 10 minutes for CHF 70 on Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays.
group: Group race arrangements with aperitif and food for company events, clubs, birthdays and weddings.
Kids' birthday parties are offered, and the track can open outside regular hours for groups on request.
hours: Mon-Tue closed; Wed-Sat 14:00-22:00; Sun 10:00-12:00 and 13:00-20:00; holiday hours separate

family: Kids' 200cc karts are for ages 8-12 (CHF 15 per 10 minutes); other single karts from age 13.
The two-seater takes passengers from age 3 accompanied by an adult (CHF 40) and suits children and people with reduced mobility.
No booking is needed for individuals or groups under 10; the venue also has Laurapark for ages 2-10, a pool and an adventure tower.
Kids' birthday packages on weekdays for ages 8-12 (CHF 30) and 13-15 (CHF 45), birthday child free.
group: Mini and Maxi Grand Prix from 10 people and team endurance races of 1-3 hours from 15 teams, booking required.
Company and group events, school races and an inter-company cup are organised.
hours: Mon-Fri 13:00-23:00; Sat 11:00-23:00; Sun 09:00-23:00; school and public holidays Mon-Sat 11:00-23:00, Sun 09:00-23:00 (indoor or outdoor depending on weather)
note: Boosted Sodi SR4 and Sodi Sport (13 hp) are used only for internal events such as the winter championship and inter-company cup.
